description: This file defines the NodePost model class in the Goteo project, responsible for managing node-post associations, including retrieving, listing, saving, and deleting such associations in the database.

classes.name: NodePost
classes.description: Represents a node-post association, providing methods to retrieve, list, save, and delete such associations in the database.

methods.name: getNodePost
methods.description: Retrieves a specific node-post association based on node_id and post_id.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of node-post associations, optionally filtered and paginated.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current node-post instance to the database, inserting or updating as needed.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes a node-post association from the database based on node_id and post_id.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the node-post instance ensuring required fields are present.
